title: 第19章 你们又输了哦第20章 上古真灵蛋
slug: 师门不要我反手建个更强的
content_zh:
这时一名散修出来道，“是云星落要和肖鹤打赌，但是肖道友似乎不敢呢。”
听说是云星落这个宗门弃徒和肖鹤打赌，段则然更来了兴致。
段则然拍着肖鹤的肩膀，“打个赌而已，你怎么不敢，不会是不行吧？”
肖鹤脸色瞬间涨红，怒道，“你才不行呢，你全家都不行。”
“那就赌咯，多大点事。”
这时苏芫芫又扯了扯肖鹤的衣角，“大师兄，要不让我来吧。”
苏芫芫信心满满，她有前世的记忆，前世上万年她不知道过去多少秘境，这样的禁制不知道解开过多少。
上次在云隐镇她丢尽了脸面，之前又被云星落摆了一道，她正想怎么找回面子呢。
想起小师妹的聪慧，肖鹤瞬间有了信心，“好，那就交给你。”
说罢，他看向云星落，“云星落，这个赌我们应下了，你说个赌注吧。”
云星落心中暗笑，他们还是入坑了。
她打了个响指，“赌注很简单，就是看谁能打开石门。
如果我打开了，天剑宗的弟子全部不能进这个洞府。
如果我打不开，苏芫芫打开了，那我云星落就不进这个洞府。
怎么样，能接受吗？”
天剑宗的弟子顿时沉默了，他们来这里的目的就是为了真灵，从刚才这个洞府散发出来的气息，里面有真灵无疑了。
谁愿意错过争抢真灵的机会呢？
陆承舟第一个出来反对，上次他们想坑云星落，没想到被反坑了，这种蠢事他不想再参与了。
“肖师兄，我们可是来寻宝的，我们还想进洞府看一看呢，你们可别连累我们。”
云星落鄙夷，“啧，连自己宗门的弟子都不相信你们，这是多菜啊！”

段则然在一旁看热闹不嫌事大，“他们一直都很菜的啦，要不然这么多年宗弟大比没有一次赢过我们太一宗。”
肖鹤脸顿时气结，“为什么一定要我们打赌，你们打赌不行吗？”
段则然：“我们又没有嫌弃云道友，更没有伤害她。”
众散修：“我们喜欢看你们打赌，不想打赌就滚蛋，这洞府你们也别想进了。”
陆承舟：“瞧你们做的好事，惹众了，当时就不应该让你带队。”
弟子甲：“就是，本来宗主让陆师兄当队长的，这肖师不知道使了什么手段，硬是把这个队长抢了去。”
弟子乙：“当队长我们没反对，关键是他不大行啊，又没魄力又没本事。”
来自宗门弟子的暴击，肖鹤感觉自己的肺离爆炸已经不远了。
“你们给我闭嘴。”
肖鹤一声大喝，“自己宗门都不团结，成什么样子，就不能相信自己人吗？”
“这个赌注我们允了。”
他温柔地看向苏芫芫，“小师妹，你放心去搏，不行有我们。”
苏芫芫点点头，其实她一点压力都没有。
content_en:
At this time, a casual cultivator came out and said, "Yun Xingluo wants to make a bet with Xiao He, but Fellow Daoist Xiao doesn't seem to dare."
Duan Zeran became even more interested when he heard that Yun Xingluo, an abandoned member of the sect, made a bet with Xiao He.
Duan Zeran patted Xiao He on the shoulder, "It's just a bet. Why don't you dare? Isn't it impossible?"
Xiao He's face instantly turned red and he said angrily, "You can't do it, your whole family can't do it."
"Then let's bet, what a big deal."
At this time, Su Xiangqian tugged on Xiao He's clothes again, "Elder brother, why don't you let me come?"
Su Qianqian was full of confidence. She had memories of her past life. She didn't know how many secret realms she had passed in the past tens of thousands of years, and she didn't know how many such restrictions had been unlocked.
She had lost all face last time in Yunyin Town, and was tricked by Yun Xingluo before. She was thinking about how to regain her face.
Thinking of his little junior sister's intelligence, Xiao He instantly gained confidence, "Okay, I'll leave it to you."
After saying that, he looked at Yun Xingluo and said, "Yun Xingluo, we should make this bet. Please tell us a bet."
Yun Xingluo secretly laughed in his heart, they were still in a trap.
She snapped her fingers, "The bet is very simple, it's to see who can open the stone door.
If I open it, all disciples of Tianjian Sect will not be able to enter this cave.
If I can't open it and Su Xiangqian does, then I, Yun Xingluo, won't be able to enter this cave.
How about it? Can you accept it? "
The disciples of the Tianjian Sect fell silent immediately. The purpose of their coming here was for the true spirit. There was no doubt that the aura emanating from the cave just now contained the true spirit.
Who wants to miss the opportunity to fight for the true spirit?
Lu Chengzhou was the first to object. Last time they tried to trick Yun Xingluo, but they were betrayed. He didn't want to participate in such stupid things anymore.
"Senior Brother Xiao, we are here to hunt for treasure. We also want to go into the cave to have a look. Please don't get us involved."
Yun Xingluo scorned, "Tsk, even the disciples of my sect don't believe you, what a waste of time!"
Duan Zeran, who was watching the excitement from the sidelines, did not think it was a big deal, "They have always been good at it, otherwise the sect disciples would never have defeated our Taiyi sect in all these years."
Xiao He's face suddenly became angry, "Why do we have to bet? Can't you make a bet?"
Duan Zeran: "We don't dislike Fellow Daoist Yun, let alone hurt her."
All the cultivators said: "We like to watch you bet. If you don't want to bet, just get out. You don't even want to enter this cave."
Lu Chengzhou: "Look at the good things you did and provoked everyone. You should not have been allowed to lead the team at that time."
Disciple A: "That's right, the sect leader originally asked Senior Brother Lu to be the captain, but this Master Xiao used some means to snatch the captain away."
Disciple B: "We have no objection to being the captain. The key is that he is not very good, has neither courage nor ability."
Xiao He felt that his lungs were not far from exploding due to the critical blow from the disciples of the sect.
"Shut up."
Xiao He shouted loudly, "If our sect is not united, how can we not trust our own people?"
"We accept this bet."
He looked at Su Xiangqian tenderly and said, "Little junior sister, don't worry and fight. You can't do it without us."
Su Qianqian nodded. In fact, she was not stressed at all.
